verdict.rationale: Crossmint's evidence is agent/buyer-side: how an agent obtains a wallet, card, or pays x402/MPP endpoints, and how a user authorizes an agent to buy 'from any merchant.' None of the evidence documents a merchant-facing self-serve path (a setting to enable, an agreement to sign, or an endpoint to publish) for a merchant to start accepting agent-initiated traffic/payments — the closest items (headless/embedded checkout) are generic payment-acceptance products not framed around agent traffic.
